prompt: Which country has the most castles
judge_reasoning: All candidates answer “which country has the most castles” with a single leading country, but none provide verifiable, source-backed counts. Candidate [3] most directly addresses the question by naming the UK (and England within it) while also explicitly noting that exact totals depend on definitions and that estimates vary. Candidate [1] is more confident (Czech Republic) and gives a broad definition caveat, but with weaker engagement with the definitional/estimation uncertainty. Candidate [2] is less aligned because it effectively gives multiple answers depending on what counts as “castles,” and [4] is the least careful, asserting Scotland with limited qualification.
